checks: Source and target are different Kubernetes clusters
Target namespace does not exist before recovery
Recovery kit has credentials and key without copied dump files
Target node has no source staging directory
Source sample and Velero belong to the backup lab
No source backup or restore is in progress
Target can reach the real source API before the fence
Target workload cannot connect to the source control plane
Source API, PostgreSQL and Velero are scaled to zero
Target uses a validated ReadOnly backup storage location
Target discovers completed backup metadata from S3 after source shutdown
Target has a different, newly issued Kubernetes CA
Cross-cluster Velero restore completes without errors
Kopia restores the dump volume on the new cluster
Dump Pod runs on the target node rather than a source node
Fresh dump and database PVCs do not reuse source identities
Dump storage class was mapped to the target local PV
Source cluster CA did not overwrite the destination CA
Application Secret came back from the backup
Restored dump matches the pre-disaster SHA-256
Destination database is empty before logical restore
Every backed-up row and field is restored in the second cluster
Schema, indexes and identity sequence match the backup
Recovered API serves all backed-up notes while the source is down
Post-backup source writes are absent at the recovered point
Recovered database accepts a new identity-backed write
Recovered data survives replacement of the new database Pod
Source API remains fenced until recovery verification ends
All current source rows and sequence survive the outage unchanged
Original source database PVC is preserved
Unrelated main lab image and PVC were untouched
Original source API connectivity returns after the rehearsal
scope: Real second kind cluster, distinct API server/CA/node/PVCs. Source sample API, PostgreSQL and Velero stopped; source API rejected from target node/pods during metadata sync, Kopia restore, SQL verification and CRUD. Main source cluster and its unrelated applications remain running. Same-host S3, no cloud/host-loss or production DNS failover claim.
final_state: Source study replicas and target network rules restored; source notes unchanged; target recovered application retained.
